title: THE FEEDBACK WINDOW SAYS CLOSE
why: His rule is CLOSE and ESC on every menu. The feedback window was the one window whose way out said CANCEL. It says CLOSE now, like every other window, and ESC still closes it.
now: The feedback window has a CLOSE button now, like every other window.
